newsitem.title: JAPAN: Sakakibara on holiday, no official speech plan - MOF.
newsitem.headline: Sakakibara on holiday, no official speech plan - MOF.

text.p: Eisuke Sakakibara, Japan's vice finance minister for international affairs, will return to work from holiday on Tuesday and has no official plan to make speeches in public in the meantime, Finance Ministry officials told Reuters on Thursday.
Japanese government bond prices were firmer in mid-morning Tokyo trade, but capped by widespread talk that Sakakibara might indicate the possibility of a rise in interest rates.
"It's really a private holiday and I don't think he has a plan to make speeches at any private functions," a ministry official said.
"He is out of Japan on holiday at a place far from work, and he is not in such places as New York, Washington or Europe," a source close to the ministry said.
